name: Daniel Sempere
role: Ten-year-old narrator, still trying to hold on to his mother’s face.

name: Mr. Sempere
role: Widowed bookseller who inherited the shop from his father.

name: Isaac Monfort
role: Keeper of the Cemetery of Forgotten Books.

name: Julián Carax
role: Unknown novelist. Daniel knows him only as the name on a spine.

name: Tomás Aguilar
role: Daniel’s inventive classmate, later his closest friend. His father wants the army for him.

name: Gustavo Barceló
role: Wealthy antiquarian with an elephantine memory for books.

name: Clara Barceló
role: Barceló’s blind niece, twenty-six, and an expert on Carax.

name: Inspector Fumero
role: Named as a wartime killer, now a policeman. Clara’s mother learned this while investigating.

name: A watching stranger
role: A limping figure Daniel thinks he sees near home. He is not yet sure the man is real.

name: Bernarda
role: The Barcelós’ maid. She opens the door and keeps Daniel in clean collars.

name: Adrián Neri
role: Clara’s music teacher. She speaks of him with admiration.

name: Laín Coubert
role: The name Isaac gives the man who buys Carax in order to burn him. It is also the devil’s name in the novel Daniel chose.

name: Fermín Romero de Torres
role: A talkative man in a doorway. He offers wine and a story about Cuban espionage.

name: Nuria Monfort
role: Isaac’s daughter. She once worked for Carax’s publisher and hid what she could.

name: Antoni Fortuny
role: A hatter. Isaac says he is Carax’s father, and that they were already estranged.

name: Sophie Carax
role: Fortuny’s wife. The caretaker says the boy was not Fortuny’s son.

name: Beatriz Aguilar
role: Tomás’s older sister. Daniel first knows her as a girl with a Falangist fiancé.

name: Pablo Buendía
role: Bea’s fiancé. A soldier who likes to talk about Spanish superiority.

name: Penélope Aldaya
role: The name on a photograph in Carax’s old room, and on a letter from 1919.

name: Jorge Aldaya
role: Named in Penélope’s letter, and by a neighbour who remembers a son.

name: Don Federico
role: The neighbourhood watchmaker. Kind, and already in Fumero’s mouth.

name: Merceditas
role: A neighbour who brings apples and does not like the police.

name: Miquel Moliner
role: The other name on Nuria’s mailbox. Later a school friend of Carax.

name: Father Fernando Ramos
role: A priest who was in Carax’s class and still keeps the school.

name: Jacinta
role: Penélope’s governess. Fernando says she is at the Santa Lucía hospice. They have not met her yet.

name: Enrique Palacios
role: A policeman who was in the rain. He says he wants to help.

name: Don Fonseca
role: The man at the morgue the night a body came in with a book and a passport.

name: Julián Sempere
role: A small boy taken to a hidden library at dawn, as his father once was.
